# 2 Baruch Chapter 26 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 26 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 26:1 — "distress-grip / hold the earth / hold the world in its grip"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "will-that-distress-grip [them]" | Literal: Syriac active verb "to grip/seize" with implied object |
| LOGOS | "will that distress hold the earth for many years" | Formal; adds "earth" as the implied object |
| PNEUMA | "will that distress hold the world in its grip for many years" | Expands for vividness |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted a hybrid: "will that distress grip the earth for many years." Retains EMET's active verb "grip" and LOGOS's "earth" as the object.

**Status:** Resolved as hybrid. Single-verse chapter, minor variation only.

---
